sources.title: Publications - Dhruva Shaw
sources.snippet: This paper proposes a novel decentralized control architecture for robotic swarms, inspired by social insect behavior. By enabling individual robots to dynamically select master-slave roles based on local information and optimize their performance using bio-inspired algorithms, this approach enhances swarm adaptability, robustness, and efficiency in tackling complex tasks across various domains.
